question: Should `litellm-api-key` interactive onboarding grow a LiteLLM-specific proxy base-URL prompt, or should remote LiteLLM proxy users be routed to Custom Provider and the broader dynamic-catalog work?
rationale: Both directions can solve the user problem, but they set different provider-owned setup UX, endpoint probing, and model-catalog ownership boundaries.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have LiteLLM interactive onboarding ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive URL support intact.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep `litellm-api-key` as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts or docs so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider for URL and model setup.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog
options.body: Leave this issue open until the broader credentialed `/v1/models` catalog policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74481 is settled.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have LiteLLM interactive onboarding ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive URL support intact.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter carried the LiteLLM pluginization and provider-onboarding refactor history closest to this setup-boundary decision.
